$comment: Pinned inputs for the Clang-WASM toolchain. Verify with `node build-memfs.mjs --verify-only`.

memfs.why: The memfs blob in binji/wasm-clang is byte-identical (345,442 bytes) to the one shipped by @chriskoch/cpp-wasm and @wasm-idle/llvm-core, so this is the published module's source.

license.note: memfs.c carries no per-file license header. Containing repos: binji/wasm-clang is Apache-2.0; binji/llvm-project is Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception. stb_sprintf.h is stb (public domain / MIT). We modify memfs.c, so Apache-2.0 section 4(b) applies: ship a notice that the file was changed. Confirm with the author before relying on this, since the file itself is unmarked.

toolchain.name: wasi-sdk
toolchain.note: Pin this version. memfs.c is 2020 code and the build relies on mechanical WASI renames; a future wasi-sdk may rename more. Re-run the feature verification when bumping.

patches.why: the capacity fix this rebuild exists for
errno constants gained ERRNO_ infix (9 constants)

patches.what: __wasi_filestat_t st_* fields lose prefix; __wasi_prestat_t pr_type -> tag

patches.why: libc abort reaches __wasi_proc_exit, a wasi_snapshot_preview1 import the runtime does not satisfy

memfs.wasm.gz.measured: drove the module directly; traps on node 4092

sysroot.why: The shipped sysroot reports _LIBCPP_VERSION 220100. At this tag all 825 shared files are byte-identical to it, so the sysroot is a pure prune with zero modifications.
